payload.body:
V3 is armed, test-only, at 5aaa4b0 -- your call on it was mine, and an arm beat a residual line.

Two arms in tests/unit/updatenotice.bats, after "a record too short to name a commit": (1) a record that is a PREFIX of the install's commit is never level; (2) a record that is a PREFIX of a row in the install's table takes no direction from it. is_commit_sha admits seven hex characters, so a shortened record does reach install_direction's comparisons.

Measured in a clean detached worktree at e72d8b4 (code identical to a6b8180) under its own TMPDIR: both green as written; V3a (head comparison as a prefix match, diff confirmed) kills arm 1 alone, which reads `level`; V3b (row comparison as a prefix match, diff confirmed) kills arm 2 alone, which reads `ahead 222222222222 1111...`; lib/helpers restored byte-identical. Both red on pre-fix 1da7bcd, reading `behind`. updatenotice.bats whole file at e72d8b4: 32/32, rc 0.

So the new-arm count is 19, 16 of them red on 1da7bcd, and your a6b8180 suite still covers every code byte. Please re-run `bats -f PREFIX tests/unit/updatenotice.bats` at 5aaa4b0 with your V3 before the verdict. I will fold your V1-V7 into the fix section with your suite line.
